reviews.text: This happened in the past, but when I tried to ask them to take care of my cat because they were nearby and open on Wednesdays, they said they couldn't take responsibility. Another time, when I asked them to take care of a stray cat, they said, "We can't take care of a stray cat."

This is a wonderful hospital where they genuinely care for their patients.

I am always very grateful for the appropriate treatment they provide.

The head veterinarian always prioritizes the animals' well-being when providing treatment, and is a very kind and gentle doctor who speaks warmly to pet owners. I feel completely at ease leaving my pet in their care.

My dog ​​is being cared for here.

The veterinarian has a somewhat reserved demeanor, but occasionally shows kindness; he's a good veterinarian. He's also easy to talk to.

All the other staff members are kind, and recently they've made it easier to book appointments via LINE.

I don't think there's another veterinarian who is so caring, animal-loving, and considerate of people. Their diagnoses are accurate, and I will continue to bring my pet there even though it's a bit far.
She is truly a doctor who cares deeply for animals and their owners.

The fact that they've implemented a reservation system is very digitally advanced and convenient.

I first took my cat there for bloody stools, but the initial treatment consisted of just a physical examination of her abdomen without any injections or anything like that. Three weeks later, she had diarrhea and bloody stools again, so I went to a different hospital for a second opinion. There, they gave injections and prescribed medication right from the first visit.

In comparison, I feel that my experience at this hospital was pointless for my cat. I think compatibility with the veterinarian is also a factor.

This hospital is located right next to Kitashinagawa Station, and the interior is clean and tidy. The doctors and staff are kind and provide accurate treatment. It is located in the Kitashinagawa shopping district.

I brought my kitten in for an examination. The staff were kind and attentive, which put me at ease. The doctor gave an accurate diagnosis and explained what to do next, which made me feel very confident in their abilities. Although it's by appointment only, the process leading up to the examination is smooth, which is helpful because it makes it easier to get my kitten seen even if I don't have a large block of time available due to work.
